list.name: charge
list.label: Ladevorgang
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, to_char(time, 'DD.MM.YY HH24:MI') || '  ' || charge_type || '  ' || round(energy_kwh::numeric) || ' kWh  ' || round(soc_start::numeric) || '→' || round(soc_end::numeric) || ' %' AS __text FROM grafana_charges WHERE energy_kwh >= 5 AND soc_end > soc_start ORDER BY time DESC

panels.title: Fahrten

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Fahrten", round(sum(km)::numeric) AS "km",
       round(avg(km)::numeric, 1) AS "Ø km je Fahrt",
       round((sum(kwh100_soc * km) / nullif(sum(km) FILTER (WHERE kwh100_soc IS NOT NULL), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Ø kWh/100 km",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE recorded) AS "aufgezeichnet"
FROM grafana_drives WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

panels.description: Ø kWh/100 km aus dem Rückgang des Ladestands mal Akkukapazität, nach Strecke gewichtet, nur Fahrten ab 15 km (der Ladestand hat ganze Prozent).

panels.title: Laden

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Ladevorgänge", round(sum(energy_kwh)::numeric) AS "kWh",
       round((sum(energy_kwh) FILTER (WHERE charge_type = 'DC'))::numeric) AS "davon DC kWh",
       round(sum(cost_eur)::numeric) AS "€ (Hauspreis)",
       round(avg(kwh_per_pct)::numeric, 3) AS "kWh je %"
FROM grafana_charges WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

panels.description: € mit dem Strompreis aus dem Fahrzeugprofil, also ohne die Preise an Schnellladern. kWh je % ist die Energie, die ein Prozent Ladestand kostet (Ladevorgänge ab 5 % Gewinn) - steigende Werte heißen mehr Ladeverluste, fallende eine kleinere nutzbare Kapazität.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', time) AS time, round(sum(km)::numeric) AS "km"
FROM grafana_drives WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', time) AS time,
       round((sum(energy_kwh) FILTER (WHERE charge_type = 'AC'))::numeric) AS "AC",
       round((sum(energy_kwh) FILTER (WHERE charge_type = 'DC'))::numeric) AS "DC"
FROM grafana_charges WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Verbrauch pro Monat (kWh/100 km)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', time) AS time,
       round((sum(kwh100_soc * km) / nullif(sum(km) FILTER (WHERE kwh100_soc IS NOT NULL), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "aus Ladestand",
       round((100 * sum(kwh_dongle) / nullif(sum(km) FILTER (WHERE kwh_dongle IS NOT NULL AND km >= 1), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Dongle"
FROM grafana_drives WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Zwei Messungen derselben Größe: der Rückgang des Ladestands (alle Fahrten ab 15 km) und die Energiezähler des Dongles (nur aufgezeichnete Fahrten). Der Winter zeigt sich hier zuerst.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS time, odo_end AS "Kilometerstand"
FROM grafana_drives WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND odo_end IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT lpad(hour::int::text, 2, '0') AS "Klasse", count(*) AS "Fahrten",
       round(sum(km)::numeric) AS "km"
FROM grafana_drives WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

panels.title: Fahrtlängen

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cls AS "Klasse", count(*) AS "Fahrten", round(sum(km)::numeric) AS "km"
FROM (SELECT km, CASE WHEN km < 5 THEN '1: <5' WHEN km < 10 THEN '2: 5-10'
                      WHEN km < 20 THEN '3: 10-20' WHEN km < 50 THEN '4: 20-50'
                      WHEN km < 150 THEN '5: 50-150' ELSE '6: 150+' END AS cls
      FROM grafana_drives WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) q GROUP BY cls ORDER BY cls

panels.description: Wenige lange Fahrten machen oft den Großteil der Kilometer aus.

panels.title: Ladestand bei Ladebeginn

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lpad((floor(soc_start / 10) * 10)::int::text, 3, ' ') || ' %' AS "Klasse",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE charge_type = 'AC') AS "AC",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE charge_type = 'DC') AS "DC"
FROM grafana_charges WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND soc_start IS NOT NULL AND energy_kwh >= 1
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Ladevorgänge ab 1 kWh: wie weit der Akku leer war, als geladen wurde.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE weekday::int WHEN 1 THEN '1 Mo' WHEN 2 THEN '2 Di' WHEN 3 THEN '3 Mi'
                   WHEN 4 THEN '4 Do' WHEN 5 THEN '5 Fr' WHEN 6 THEN '6 Sa' ELSE '7 So' END AS "Klasse",
       round((sum(kwh100_soc * km) / nullif(sum(km) FILTER (WHERE kwh100_soc IS NOT NULL), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "kWh/100 km",
       round(sum(km)::numeric) AS "km"
FROM grafana_drives WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY weekday

panels.title: Ladevorgänge: Energie über Ladestand-Gewinn

targets.rawSql:
SELECT soc_gain AS "Ladestand-Gewinn %",
       CASE WHEN charge_type = 'AC' THEN energy_kwh END AS "AC kWh",
       CASE WHEN charge_type = 'DC' THEN energy_kwh END AS "DC kWh"
FROM grafana_charges WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND soc_gain > 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Liegen die Punkte auf einer Geraden, passt die Ladeenergie zum Ladestand. Ihre Steigung ist die Energie je Prozent, also etwa ein Hundertstel der nutzbaren Kapazität plus Ladeverluste.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time AS "Start", round(duration_min::numeric) AS "Min",
       round(km::numeric, 1) AS "km", soc_start AS "SoC Start", soc_end AS "SoC Ende",
       round(kwh100_soc::numeric, 1) AS "kWh/100 Ladestand",
       round(kwh100_dongle::numeric, 1) AS "kWh/100 Dongle",
       round(speed_avg::numeric) AS "Ø km/h", odo_end AS "Kilometerstand",
       replace(replace(replace(sources, 'vw_history', 'VW'), 'vw_portal', 'VW'), '"', '') AS "Quelle",
       live_session_id AS "Aufzeichnung",
       (extract(epoch FROM time) * 1000)::bigint AS von,
       (extract(epoch FROM ended_at) * 1000 + 60000)::bigint AS bis
FROM grafana_drives WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT time AS "Start", charge_type AS "Art", round(duration_min::numeric) AS "Min",
       round(energy_kwh::numeric, 1) AS "kWh", round(max_power_kw::numeric) AS "max kW",
       soc_start AS "SoC Start", soc_end AS "SoC Ende",
       round(kwh_per_pct::numeric, 3) AS "kWh je %", odometer_km AS "Kilometerstand"
FROM grafana_charges WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: VW-Portal: Ladestand und Reichweite

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, soc_pct AS "Ladestand %", range_km AS "Reichweite km"
FROM grafana_reports WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Jede Meldung des Autos an das VW-Portal (beim Ein- und Ausschalten, beim Laden). Erst seit dem Einschalten des Portal-Abrufs.

panels.title: VW-Portal: Akkutemperatur und nutzbare Kapazität

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, batt_temp_min_c AS "Akku min °C", batt_temp_max_c AS "Akku max °C",
       capacity_kwh AS "nutzbar kWh"
FROM grafana_reports WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Die nutzbare Kapazität (maximaler Energieinhalt laut Auto) sinkt mit dem Alter des Akkus - über Monate betrachtet ist das die Akkugesundheit.

panels.title: Ladekurve: ${charge:text}

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kw AS "kW", soc AS "Ladestand %" FROM grafana_charge_curve
WHERE charge_id = ${charge} ORDER BY time

panels.description: Ladevorgang oben in der Auswahl „Ladevorgang“ wählen. Leistung auf der x-Achse, Ladestand auf der y-Achse. Der Ladestand zwischen Anfang und Ende ist aus der bis dahin geladenen Energie geschätzt: das Auto meldet die Leistung laufend, den Ladestand im Fahrtenbuch nur am Anfang und Ende.

panels.title: Alle DC-Ladekurven im Zeitraum

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kw AS "kW", soc AS "Ladestand %" FROM grafana_charge_curve
WHERE charge_type = 'DC' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY charge_id, time

panels.description: Jeder Punkt ein Messwert eines DC-Ladevorgangs: die obere Kante ist, was der Akku bei welchem Ladestand höchstens annimmt; Punkte darunter sind kalter Akku, schwache Säule oder geteilte Leistung. Leistung auf der x-Achse, Ladestand auf der y-Achse. Der Ladestand zwischen Anfang und Ende ist aus der bis dahin geladenen Energie geschätzt: das Auto meldet die Leistung laufend, den Ladestand im Fahrtenbuch nur am Anfang und Ende.
